_comment: Validation measured on its OWN frequency grid. Only 'lines' and 'validation_db' are available; 'box' and 'error' difference the two spectra point by point and are rejected. validation_db draws its dB overlay panel only, since the level error dL needs paired frequencies.

input._validation_frequencies_forms: path to a 1-D .npy / single-variable .mat, an inline list [10, 15, 20], or {"min": 10, "step": 5, "max": 200}

plot.title: Uplifted CPSD diagonal: measured vs computed

output._top_n_note: on an independent grid this caps in SELECTION order, not worst-error order
